newsitem.title: USA: WCE canola up sharply on StatsCan data, CBOT soy.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola up sharply on StatsCan data, CBOT soy.

text.p: WCE canola futures opened sharply higher with old crop boosted by surging CBOT soybeans and new crop aided by a bullish planting intentions report issued by Statistics Canada, traders said.
At 0933 CDT July canola was up C$3.20 at C$430.50 a tonne with November C$5.40 higher at C$387.00.
StatsCan put Canadian canola planting intentions at 11.6 million acres, up 30 percent from last year but below most trade expectations which ranged from around 12.0 to 12.75 million.
